title: Error while compiling export template with build profile disabling Geometry3D
body:
### Tested versions

It is not Godot's error, but rather the build system's thing.

### System information

Windows 11 (build 22631) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Radeon RX550/550 Series (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.11000) - Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU G4400 @ 3.30GHz (2 threads) - 15.94 GiB memory

### Issue description

Error while compiling custom export template with custom build profile and script encryption key using Windows Terminal on Windows 11:

`$env:SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY="mykeyhere..."`

`scons p=windows target=template_release tools=no build_profile="buildprofile.gdbuild"`

Not sure if this is duplicate issue, as i searched for this **exact** thing and i couldn't find more issues regarding this same type of error, but there are some with some similarities.

**Error:**

```
godot master *% = $ scons p=windows target=template_release tools=no build_profile="buildprofile.gdbuild"
scons: Reading SConscript files ...
Auto-detected 2 CPU cores available for build parallelism. Using 2 cores by default. You can override it with the `-j` or `num_jobs` arguments.
Using feature build profile: "buildprofile.gdbuild"
Building for platform "windows", architecture "x86_64", target "template_release".

*** IMPORTANT: Compiling Godot with custom `SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY` set as environment variable.
*** Make sure to use templates compiled with this key when exporting a project with encryption.

INFO: Performing initial build, progress percentage unavailable!
scons: done reading SConscript files.
scons: Building targets ...
Compiling main\main.cpp ...
Compiling main\performance.cpp ...
.\servers/rendering/rendering_server.h(42): error C2757: 'Geometry3D': a symbol with this name already exists and therefore this name cannot be used as a namespace name
scons: *** [bin\obj\main\performance.windows.template_release.x86_64.obj] Error 2
.\servers/rendering/rendering_server.h(42): error C2757: 'Geometry3D': a symbol with this name already exists and therefore this name cannot be used as a namespace name
scons: *** [bin\obj\main\main.windows.template_release.x86_64.obj] Error 2
scons: building terminated because of errors.
INFO: Time elapsed: 00:00:19.86
```

### Steps to reproduce

Just trying to compile custom export template, using:

Note that the build profile was generated in the latest Godot 4.6.1 stable, and i fixed it by removing the Mutex, Time and Window from the _disabled classes_ as per this https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113595

`$env:SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY="mykeyhere..."`

`scons p=windows target=template_release tools=no build_profile="buildprofile.gdbuild"`

_All above commands were taken from the official Godot's docs!_

in ~20 seconds the aforementioned error is printed out

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Not sure how to create this as it is not an engine problem, but something to do with build system...
